card.name: Words just before talks or dialogue
card.fires_on: Words in diplomatic or negotiation text where the next word is likely "talks", "negotiations" or "dialogue". Typical triggers are "to", "for", "of", "launched" and "inter" in a passage about peace or trade between countries.

modes.label: Linking words before talks
modes.description: A small word like "to", "for" or "of" that leads into a talks or negotiation term in a political passage.

modes.label: Verbs and partial words about talks
modes.description: A verb or partial word in a diplomacy setting that is followed by talks or dialogue.
modes.example: the US and Oman<< launched>> negotiations on a Free Trade Agreement

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word dialogue (and dialog) next.
card.plain: It lights up when a passage about diplomacy or peace is about to say "dialogue" or "talks".
